newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil advance soybean sales ahead of 1995 -Safras.
newsitem.headline: Brazil advance soybean sales ahead of 1995 -Safras.

text.p: Brazilian soybean producers have sold forward around 3.78 million tonnes or 15 percent of the 1996/97 crop, independent consultants Safras e Mercado said in a press release.
This compares with seven percent last year and an historical average of 12 percent, it added.
The higher level of advance sales is due to better prices for soybeans and soyproducts during most of this year both in the internal and the international markets.
Based on planting intentions, Brazil's 1996/97 soybean crop should reach 25.89 million tonnes, Safras said.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
